title: Languages
html:
The game currently supports these languages (Vietnamese was added in Update 34.0):

  • Arabic
  • Bengali
  • Brazilian Portuguese
  • Bulgarian
  • Catalan
  • Czech
  • Danish
  • Dutch
  • English
  • Esperanto
  • Estonian
  • European Portuguese
  • Finnish
  • French
  • Galician
  • German
  • Greek
  • Hebrew
  • Hindi
  • Hungarian
  • Indonesian
  • Italian
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Macedonian
  • Persian
  • Polish
  • Russian
  • Serbo-Croatian
  • Simplified Chinese
  • Slovak
  • Slovenian
  • Spanish
  • Swedish
  • Swiss German
  • Toki Pona
  • Traditional Chinese
  • Turkish
  • Ukrainian
  • Vietnamese

On the Steam client, Steam’s locale is used as the default language.

Contributing

Information can be found on the Github page.
